How we work with each kind of brand

The same discipline. A different job for each kind.

Every audience buys differently, so the work starts from a different question.

D2C

A shopper decides in seconds, on a phone.

We start from the margin on an order, then shape ads, creative, the store and retention around it.

See D2C brands →
B2B

A buyer researches for weeks and talks to several people.

We build a clear website, useful proof and lead generation that filters for fit, then help the follow-up so leads become conversations.

See B2B companies →
Education

A family compares colleges over weeks, with a deadline.

We run search and paid campaigns around courses and intakes, and follow every enquiry up until it becomes an enrolment.

See Education brands →
Other consumer

A big purchase, a long think, and the sale often closes offline.

We build enquiry-led funnels: clear pages, targeted media and quick follow-up by call or message, judged on the cost of a real enquiry.

How the audit works →
Beyond D2C

Consumer brands beyond the online shop.

Some of the brands on the wall sell homes, holidays or rides rather than products. The job there is a steady flow of real enquiries.

Property

Buyers visit, compare and come back. Follow-up decides who they choose.

Hospitality

People book a stay on a picture and a feeling. Photos and clear offers do the work.

Mobility

Local demand, quick decisions. Search and simple lead paths bring the calls.

Common questions

Questions about our work.

What kinds of brands does MMC work with?

D2C brands that sell direct to shoppers, B2B companies that win business from other businesses, and education brands that enrol students. We also work with other consumer-facing brands such as property, hospitality and mobility. See the D2C, B2B and education pages.

Why do some brands only show a logo, with no case study?

A case study needs real artwork or a work image on record. Where we only have a logo, we show the logo and the services recorded for that brand, and nothing more, rather than guess at what a page might have looked like.

Do you publish results for each brand?

Not on this page. We do not publish performance figures unless we can back them up with real, checkable numbers. The way we judge our own work is in the contribution margin and break-even ROAS guide.

Can you work with a brand like ours if it is not on the wall?

Very likely. The approach is the same whatever the category: work out what a sale or an enrolment is worth, then build the media, creative and follow-up around it. A free audit is the quickest way to find out.
